Title: Maybe It's Mackerel
Writer: Warren Hsu Leonard, Jared Lopez, Raffi Donatich
Actors: Ella Rubin, Amélie Hoeferle, Jacob Whiteduck-Lavoie
Plot: As the potential sale of Sterling Point looms, Ramona wrestles with her decision while Annie and friends try to sway her. When Ramona's past and future collide, an emotional confrontation leads to a twist that changes everything.
